question: Who was the first woman to receive Jnanpith award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashapoorna Devi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ashapoorna Devi** (1909−1995) was a prominent **Bengali novelist and poet** who achieved the distinction of being the **first woman** to win the **Jnanpith Award**.
 
• She was conferred with this prestigious literary honor in **1976** for her celebrated novel **Pratham Pratishruti** (The First Promise), which was published in **1964**.
 
• The **Jnanpith Award** is India's highest literary award, presented annually by the **Bharatiya Jnanpith** to an author for their 'outstanding contribution towards literature'.
 
• Her literary career was remarkably prolific, spanning over **seven decades** and including more than **180 novels** and **1,500 short stories**.
 
• She primarily focused on the struggles and aspirations of women within the **traditional Bengali middle-class** social structure during the **20th century**.
 
• In addition to the Jnanpith, she was awarded the **Padma Shri** by the Government of India in **1976** and the **Sahitya Akademi Fellowship** in **1994**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amrita Pritam**:

 
 
• She was a leading **Punjabi** writer and poet who received the **Jnanpith Award** in **1981** for her collection **Kagaz Te Kanwas**.
 
• She was the first woman to win the **Sahitya Akademi Award** in **1956** for her poem **Sunehade**.
 
 
 
• **Mahasveta Devi**:
 
 
• A renowned **Bengali** author and social activist who was honored with the **Jnanpith Award** in **1996**.
 
• Her famous works include **Hajar Churashir Maa** and **Aranyer Adhikar**, often focusing on the rights of **tribal communities**.
 
 
 
• **Qurratulain Hyder**:
 
 
• An influential figure in **Urdu literature**, she won the **Jnanpith Award** in **1989**.
 
• Her most notable work is the historical novel **Aag Ka Darya** (River of Fire).
